user.title: Add a device
user.description: Choose the protocol and device type. Each device (decoder, receiver) becomes one entry; its outputs become destinations of the matrix.

device.title: {device}
device.description: The connection is tested before the device is added.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the device, e.g. 192.0.2.10.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default port of this device type.
data_description.password: Magewell factory default: Admin (change it!). BirdDog: only needed if the API requires a login.
data_description.name: Defaults to the device's own name.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure device
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the device, e.g. 192.0.2.10.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default port of this device type.
data_description.password: Magewell factory default: Admin (change it!). BirdDog: only needed if the API requires a login.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device (wrong address/port, or it is not this device type).
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the user name or password.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different device.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two polls. Offline devices are retried with a growing pause (up to 30 s).

display.title: Linked display: {destination}
display.description: Optional: a TV or projector (any media_player) fed by this destination. Leave empty for none.

data.auto_on: Power on and switch input on route
data.off_on_none: Turn display off when routed to None

display_input.title: Display input: {destination}
display_input.description: Input of {display} the decoder is connected to (e.g. HDMI 2). Leave empty to only power it on.

no_destination.message: No AV Matrix destination in the target.

route.name: Route
route.description: Route a source to one or more destinations.

source.name: Source
source.description: Source name (NDI®: the full NDI name) or its label. "None" switches the destination off.

salvo.name: Salvo
salvo.description: Switch several destinations at once. All are validated first; if one is unknown or locked, nothing is switched.

routes.name: Routes
routes.description: List of routes, each with destination (a source select entity) and source (name, label or None).

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Restore the previous source of destinations.

refresh_sources.name: Refresh sources
refresh_sources.description: Let the devices rebuild their source lists.
